Sequential (chained) fits for one seed

run_sequential_fits.Rd

Screens n_screen random starts (plus the default start), then for each loss function runs n_rounds fits, each starting from the previous round's optimum, cycling through chain_methods.

Usage

run_sequential_fits(
  samodel,
  xt,
  seed,
  default_pars,
  tswitch,
  nyears,
  use_switch = TRUE,
  use_log = TRUE,
  losses = names(loss_functions),
  chain_methods = c("nmkb", "lbfgsb", "hjkb"),
  n_rounds = 6,
  start_from = "screen",
  n_screen = 20000,
  maxfeval = 20000,
  rel_tol = NULL,
  parallel = TRUE,
  n_workers = max(1, parallelly::availableCores() - 1)
)

Arguments

samodel

The model structure, e.g. from build_samodel().

xt

Grouped x(t) to fit to.

seed

Random seed for this run.

default_pars

The CC_MAGIC parameters, used as the default start.

tswitch

Time of the vaccine switch.

nyears

Number of (final) years to fit.

use_switch

Use the vaccine switch.

use_log

Minimise log(loss) instead of the loss.

losses

Names of the loss functions to fit.

chain_methods

Optimizers, cycled through the rounds.

n_rounds

Rounds per chain.

start_from

"screen", "random", "default", or a numeric start vector.

n_screen

Number of random starts to screen.

maxfeval

Evaluation budget per fit.

rel_tol

Stop a chain when the relative improvement falls below this, or NULL to always run all rounds.

parallel, n_workers

Parallelise the start screen.

Value

A list with seed, summary and parameters (both with a "round_00" start row per loss and a seed column), screen (losses x starts, or NULL) and fits (all fit objects).
